headings.usage: All section titles, hero text, and modal headers. Use 'italic' for accent words.

body.usage: UI elements, buttons, paragraphs, data tables.

mono.usage: Time slots, price tags, technical details.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(180%); bg-black/40; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)

login_page.style: The image side must have a gold tint overlay. The form side must be Deep Obsidian with Gold borders.
login_page.credentials_display: Use a 'glass' card floating on the bottom left of the image section.

dashboard_manager.sidebar: Collapsed by default on mobile, fixed width (80px) on desktop to maximize calendar space.
dashboard_manager.calendar_style: Custom styling. Current day = Gold Border. Booked slots = Charcoal bg with Gold text.
dashboard_manager.widgets: Use 'Cardless' style with sharp borders for appointment lists.

client_booking.grid: Grid Mode A (Tetris) for Service Selection.
client_booking.steps: Wizard format: Services -> Barber -> Time -> Confirm.
client_booking.cards: Service cards should be tall with image top, text bottom. Hover = Image zooms slightly, border glows gold.

component_instructions.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none). Primary: Gold bg, Black text, uppercase, tracking-widest. Secondary: Transparent bg, Gold border, Gold text.
component_instructions.inputs: bg-transparent border-b border-white/20 focus:border-gold_foil. No outlines. Ghost text.
component_instructions.cards: bg-[#121212] border border-white/5 hover:border-gold_foil/50 transition-colors duration-300.
component_instructions.modals: Backdrop blur-xl. Modal content: Obsidian bg with thin gold border.
component_instructions.calendar: Override Shadcn calendar. Days must be square. Selected day = Gold circle.

universal_guidelines: Dark Mode ONLY. No light mode toggle.
Always apply a subtle noise texture to the background using specific CSS.
Animations: Use framer-motion for smooth page transitions (fade-in + slide-up).
Data-Test-ID: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
